content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD sediment transport / morphology module (Babak Tehranirad; merged to 3.1beta by Fengyan Shi 06/09/2017), entirely inside # if defined (SEDIMENT) (L1) ... # endif (L886). eval_sed_load (L9-185, called by MAIN): sets H=Eta*Gamma3+Depth+Zb (L15, repeated L182), viscosity=0.00000100 (L16), Dstar=D50*((Sdensity-1)*grav/viscosity**2)**(1/3) (L17), Tau_cr=(Sdensity-1)*grav*D50*Shields_cr (L18), k_s=2.5*D50 (L20), clamps H to MinDepth (L21-25); if Sed_Scheme(1:3)=='Upw' (L26) it does an explicit upwind advection-diffusion update of depth-averaged concentration CH: cell speeds u_c..u_c4 (L32-36), shear velocities ustar_c..ustar_c4=0.4*u_c/(-1+log(30*MAX(H(I+1,J),MinDepth)/k_s)) (L38-42, all using H(I+1,J)), diffusivities k1..k4=5.93*(ustar+ustar_c)*(H+H)/4 (L45-48), upwinded face fluxes F1..F4 with -k*(H+H)*(dCH)/2/D{X,Y} diffusion (L49-77), shoreline BC zeroing fluxes next to MASK<1 (L78-90), wall BC via npx/npy/px/py (L92-109), then Delta_c=((Pickup-D)*DX*DY-(F1-F2)*DY-(F3-F4)*DX)*DT/DX/DY/H (L113-114) and CH+=Delta_c (L116); pickup via van Rijn-type law: tau_xy=0.16/(1+log(k_s/(30*MAX(H(I+1,J),MinDepth))))**2*u_c**2 (L128), c_b=0.015*((tau_xy-Tau_cr)/Tau_cr)**1.50*Dstar**(-0.3) (L131), reduction=MIN(1,0.65/c_b) (L132), c_a=reduction*c_b*D50/(0.01*H(I+1,J)) (L133), Pickup=MAX(0,c_a*WS) (L134), zeroed on dry/hard-bottom (L136-143); deposition D per Cao(2004) (L151-153); ELSE branch (non-Upw): 3-stage Runge-Kutta CH0=CH (L161) then sediment_flux/sediment_source/sediment_solver(ISTAGE)/EXCHANGE loop (L162-167); hard-bottom block commented (L171-180). sediment_solver(ISTEP) (L187-223): finite-volume RK update RS=(-1/DX*(F_right*n_right+F_left*n_left)-1/DY*(F_top*n_top+F_bottom*n_bottom)+Sed_Source)/H (L209-211) with face fluxes from Fs/Gs (L204-207), CH=MAX(0,ALPHA(ISTEP)*CH0+BETA(ISTEP)*(CH+DT*RS))*FLOAT(MASK) (L212-213), CH capped at .750_SP/13.0_SP (L214-217). sediment_source (L225-290): same Dstar/Tau_cr/k_s setup with SP-suffixed literals (L237-240), deposition D (Cao 2004, L249-250, mask check commented L247), pickup with exponents 2.40 and Dstar**(-0.6) (L270), plus caps: Pickup=0 when CH>=.50_SP/13.0_SP (L280-282), when H<=MinDepth*1.2 (L283), and on hard bottom Zb>=Zs-0.001 (L284-286). sediment_flux (L293-479): CHX/CHY from DERIVATIVE_X_High/DERIVATIVE_Y_High (L305-306), CHH=CH*H (L307), 4th-order reconstruction via CONSTRUCT_HO_X (L314-318, passing DX and MASK; operands U,V,CH,CHX,Eta) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L335-339), interface depths HxL/R=EtaRx+Depthx+Zb (L319-320), HyL/R (L340-341); sediment fluxes FsL/FsR (L322-332) and GsL/GsR (L343-355) = CHHx*U*H - H*CHXx*5.93*H*|u|*0.4/(-1+log(30*MAX(H,MinDepth)/k_s)) (advection minus gradient diffusion); WAVE_SPEED (L358-359) then HLLC Riemann solves for Fs (L362) and Gs (L363); boundary conditions zero Fs/Gs on the four physical edges with PARALLEL neighbor guards and COUPLING nesting windows (L368-460); dry-point flux zeroing over Jbeg-1..Jend+1 x Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L469-476) with Jeff's inter-processor caveat comment (L463-467). update_bed (L481-885, called by main): accumulates P_ave/D_ave each step (L492-503); every Morph_step steps averages them (L510-515), saves ZbOld (L518), increments counter_ava (L519), and advances bed with 3-stage RK Zb=ALPHA(ISTEP)*ZbOld+BETA(ISTEP)*(Zb+DT1*htt) where htt=(P_ave-D_ave)/(1-n_porosity) if H>1.2*MinDepth else -D_ave/(1-n_porosity) (L525-530 odd-counter J,I sweep; L616-622 even-counter I,J sweep), with in-loop avalanche slope-limiting when |d(Depth+Zb)|/D{X,Y}>tan_phi moves 0.5*(dz+D*tan_phi) between neighbors, clipped by hard-bottom Zs when IN_Mask_s (odd sweep L536-609, even sweep L628-701); resets Counter_s=0, DT1=0.0_SP (L706-707); afterwards a global avalanche relaxation loop (L710-884): label 96 (L713), c_dum counter with escape IF(c_dum.GT.1000) GO TO 86 (L716), re-scans the whole grid restarting via GO TO 96 after every single adjustment, odd-counter J,I sweep (L717-...) and even-counter I,J sweep (from L799), terminating at label 86 continue (L883) before END SUBROUTINE update_bed (L884). No file I/O. Data blocks: none (source code).

verbatim_spans.text: ! Jeff pointed out the loop should be Jbeg-1, Jend+1

unresolved: eval_sed_load L38-42: ustar_c through ustar_c4 all divide by log(30*MAX(H(I+1,J),MinDepth)/k_s) although they correspond to velocities at (I,J),(I+1,J),(I-1,J),(I,J+1),(I,J-1) -- apparent copy-paste of H(I+1,J); likewise tau_xy L128 and c_a L133 use H(I+1,J) instead of H(I,J).
F4 upwind branch inconsistency: IF branch L72-73 uses -k4*(H(I,J+1)+H(I,J)) for the bottom (J-1) face while the ELSE branch L75-76 uses -k4*(H(I,J-1)+H(I,J)); relation L73 vs L76.

Pickup laws differ between branches: Upw branch c_b exponent 1.50 and Dstar**(-0.3) (L131) vs RK-branch sediment_source 2.40 and Dstar**(-0.6) (L270); Upw branch lacks the CH>=.50/13 and H<=1.2*MinDepth pickup caps present at L280-283.

sediment_flux calls CONSTRUCT_HO_X with 12 arguments including DX (L314-318) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y with DY (L335-339), but CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y defined in fluxes.F of this same source tree take 11 arguments without DX/DY (the DX-bearing variants there are CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod); which routine actually binds cannot be resolved from this file.

L316/L337 pass CH (not CHH) into outputs named CHHxL/CHHyL; CHH=CH*H computed at L307 is never used afterwards -- the flux formulas L322/L343 multiply CHHxL by HxL, so CHHxL actually holds reconstructed CH.
eval_sed_load declares ISTEP (L12) but never uses it (ISTAGE is the loop variable L162); Delta_c divides by H(I,J) with the MAX(H,MinDepth) guard commented out (L114).

Many work variables (u_c,u_c1-4,ustar_c*,k1-4,F1-4,tau_xy,c_b,reduction,c_a,Delta_c,CH0,htt,counter_ava,c_dum,tan_phi,ava,Zs,P_ave,D_ave,Counter_s,Morph_step,DT1,CHX,CHY,CHH,CHHxL...,FsL/R,GsL/R,Fs,Gs) are not declared in this file -- all assumed from USE GLOBAL; not resolvable here.

update_bed avalanche relaxation (L710-884) restarts the full-grid scan from label 96 after every single cell adjustment (GO TO 96) with only c_dum>1000 escape (L716) -- O(1000) full-grid rescans possible per morphology step; the odd/even counter_ava sweeps alternate J-first (L522-523, L718-719) vs I-first (L614-615, from L799) loop order.

sediment_solver caps CH at .750_SP/13.0_SP (L214-217) with the compensating Zb feedback commented out (L215); cap constant differs from the .50_SP/13.0_SP pickup cutoff (L280) -- rationale not stated in file.
sediment_flux wall BCs zero only the normal fluxes at domain edges (L368-460); unlike eval_sed_load's Upw branch there is no py==1 special case for the y-direction.
